title: Korea Entry Requirements 2026-27: Check These Forms
summary: Korea entry requirements depend on your passport and arrival date. Learn when US and UK visitors need a K-ETA or e-Arrival Card, and where to check the rules for other passports.

slides.title: Check Your Entry Forms
slides.voice: Korea entry rules vary by passport. Check first.

slides.title: Arriving By Dec 2026
slides.voice: US and UK tourists: visa-free up to ninety days. Through December thirty-first, twenty twenty-six, skip K-ETA; file the free e-Arrival Card within three days before arrival.

slides.title: Arriving From Jan 2027
slides.voice: From January first, twenty twenty-seven, K-ETA is expected. Apply seventy-two hours early; check k-eta.go.kr for updates.

slides.title: Check Your Own Rules
slides.sub: Use official visa and K-ETA sites
slides.voice: Other passports: check visa.go.kr and k-eta.go.kr. Without K-ETA, file the free e-Arrival Card within three days before arrival.

slides.title: New Korea tips
slides.voice: Subscribe for more Korea tips every Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.
